title: Checkout v1

intent.summary: Let shoppers pay in one pass and recover from a declined card without losing their cart.
goals: Fewer abandoned checkouts after a declined card
Shipping and payment on separate, short screens

modified.name: Banner
changes: Adds an action link inside danger banners

dataAndBehavior.description: Submitting shows Processing, then either Confirmed or Card declined. The prototype picks the result from the fixture.
Address lookup is mocked; the invalid-address fixture simulates a failed lookup.

resolvedAnnotations.body: Error copy should say what to do next, not just what went wrong.
Should Pay now be disabled until the card number is valid?
resolvedAnnotations.resolution: No. Keep it enabled and show inline errors on submit.

openQuestions.question: Do we retry the payment automatically once before showing Card declined?

acceptanceCriteria: A declined card returns the shopper to the payment form with their cart and shipping details intact.
The declined-card banner tells the shopper what to try next.
Pay now stays enabled; invalid fields show inline errors on submit.

notTrustworthy: Error handling beyond what the fixtures show
